verses.7: Bana dure milatissiya asi de7ees; shin au aibinne baawa; harai qassi bana hiyyeesa milatissiyaagee de7ees; shin au daro aqoi de7ees.
verses.8: Asi ba miishshan ba shemppuwaa wozanau danddayees; shin hiyyeesaa yashissiyaabi baawa.
verses.9: Xillotussi ubbatoo poo7o; shin iitatu xomppee to7ana.
verses.10: Otoroi ooshshaa yelees; shin zoriyaa ekkiyaageeti aadhdhida eranchcha.
verses.11: Daafuri bainnan demmido miishshai eesuwan xayees; shin minni oottidi demmido aqoi, dari daridi bees.
verses.12: Koyiyoobai polettennan gam77iyoogee azzanissees; shin amottidobai polettiyoogee ufaissees.
verses.13: Zore kariya uri meton gelees; shin azazuwaa bonchchiya uri saruwan de7ana.
verses.14: Aadhdhida eranchchai immiyo timirttee de7o pultto; hegee asi haiquwaa piriyaappe kessi ekkanau maaddees.
verses.15: Akeeki de7iyo uri bonchchettees; shin ammanettennan aggiyoogee bashshau efees.
verses.16: Cincca asai ubbai eran oottees; shin eeyyai ba eeyyatettaa qonccissees.
verses.17: Iita asati kiitettidi, meton geloosona; shin ammanttiya asati kiitettidi, sarotettaa ehoosona.
verses.18: Seeraa ixxiya asi hiyyeeseesinne yeellatees; shin seerin siyiya urai bonchchettees.
verses.19: Amottidobaa demmiyoogee keehi ufaissees; shin iitati iitaappe haakkanau koyokkona.
verses.20: Aadhdhida eranchcha asatuura hemettiya asi aadhdhida eranchcha gidees; shin eeyya asatuura hemettiya asi metuwan gelees.
verses.21: Nagaranchchata iita qaadai kaallees; shin xilloti lo77o oosuwaa woituwaa ekkana.
verses.22: Lo77o asi ba naatu naata laatissees; shin nagaranchchaa aqoi xilluwaassi dagattees.
verses.23: Hiyyeesaa goshshai daro kattaa aifanau danddayees; shin suure pirddai paccidoogaa gaasuwan xayees.
verses.24: Qaixaariyan wadhdhanau qarettiya uri ba na7aa ixxees; shin ba na7aa siiqiya uri minnidi seerees.
verses.25: Xilloi a uloi kallana gakkanaassi mees; shin nagaranchchai namisettees.

verses.1: Aadhdhida eranchcha maccaasiyaa ba keettaa keexxausu; shin eeyyiyaa ba keettaa ba kushiyan qolausu.
verses.2: Suure hemettiya asi GODAASSI yayyees; shin ba ogiyaa geellayiya asi GODAA karees.
verses.3: Eeyyaa haasayai a zokkuwaassi gatimaa ehees; shin aadhdhida eranchchatu inxxarssai eta naagees.
verses.4: Boorati bainnasan gootarai mela de7ees; shin neeyyo goyiyo wolqqaama boorati de7ikko, ne gootaran kattai kumees.
verses.5: Ammanettiya markkai ubbaton tumaa odees; shin worddo markkai worddo xalaalaa haasayees.
verses.6: Qilliicciyaagee aadhdhida eratettaa koyees; shin demmenna; akeekai de7iyo asi eratettaa demmanaagee a waayissenna.
verses.7: Eeyya asappe haakka; aissi giikko, neeni a haasayaappe era demmakka.
verses.8: Cincca asi ba oottiyoogaa eriyo gishshau, aadhdhida eranchcha gidees; shin eeyya asi ainne erennankka eriyaabaa milatiyo gishshau eeyya gidees.
verses.9: Eeyyati nagaraa oottidi, azzaniyoogaa gishshaa qilliiccoosona; shin suureti bantta nagarai atto geetettanau koyoosona.
verses.10: Ba wozanaa azzanuwaa aawu erees; a ufaissaakka ooninne aara koxxenna.
verses.11: Iitatu keettai qolettana; shin suuretu keettai minnidi de7ana.
verses.12: Asaassi likke milatiya ogee de7ees; shin bin, a wurssettai haiquwan kessi yeggees.
verses.13: Miichchankka wozanai azzani erees; ufaissaa wurssettaikka azzano gidanau danddayees.
verses.14: Iita asi ba iita oosuwaa waagaa ekkana; lo77o asikka ba lo77o oosuwaa waagaa ekkana.
verses.15: Eeyya asi ubbabaa ammanees; shin cinccai akeekidi tanggees.
verses.16: Aadhdhida eranchcha asi yayyees; iitaappekka haakkees; shin eeyyai banan ammanettidi otorettees.
verses.17: Elle hanqqettiya asati eeyya ooso oottoosona. SHin cinccati danddayanchcha.
verses.18: Eeyyati bantta azallatettaa waagaa ekkoosona; shin cinccati eratettaa kallachchaadan goxxoosona.
verses.19: Iita asati lo77o asatu sinttan hokkidi, maarotaa woossoosona. Nagaranchchatikka xillotu penggiyan hokkoosona.
verses.20: Hiyyeesai ba shooruwankka dosettenna; shin duretussi daro laggeti de7oosona.
verses.21: Ba shooruwaa kariya asi nagaraa oottees; shin hiyyeesaa maaddiyaageeti anjjettidaageeta.
verses.22: Iitabaa maqettiyaageeti baloosona gidokkonaa? SHin lo77obaa oottanau halchchiyaageeti tumatettaanne aggenna siiquwaa demmoosona.
verses.23: Minnidi oottidoban ubban go77ai de7ees; shin coo mela haasayai hiyeesatetta xalaalaa ehees.
verses.24: Aadhdhida eranchchatussi eta duretettai etau kallachcha; shin eeyyati bantta eeyyatettaa gujji gujjidi eeyyoosona.
verses.25: Tumu markkai shemppuwaa ashshees; shin worddo markkai kashi erikke gees.
verses.26: GODAASSI yayyiya urau mino qatoi de7ees. I a naatussikka baqatidi attiyo soho gidana.
verses.27: GODAASSI yayyiyoogee de7oi kiyiyo pultto; hegaa gishshau, neeni haiquwaappe kessa ekkanau koyikko, GODAASSI yayya.
verses.28: Kawuwaa gitatettai i haariyo asaa coratettaana; shin haariyo asi xayikko, ikka pattenna.
verses.29: Danddayanchcha asaassi gita akeekai de7ees; shin elle hanqqettiya asi ba eeyyatettaa qonccissees.
verses.30: Woppu giida wozanai bollaa payya wottees; shin qanaatee bollau ajaajje harggiyaa mala.
verses.31: Hiyyeesata toochchiya asi eta Medhdhidaagaa cayees; shin metootanchchatussi kehiya asi Xoossaa bonchchees.
verses.32: Iitati bantta iita oosuwan kunddana; shin xilloti bantta suuretettan naagettana.
verses.33: Akeekanchcha asaa wozanan aadhdhida eratettai kumiis; shin eeyyati aadhdhida eratettaabaa aibanne erokkona.
verses.34: Xillotettai issi kawotettaa asaa xoqqu xoqqu oottees; shin nagarai ai asanne kaushshees.
verses.35: Kawoi eranchcha ashkkaran ufaittees; shin yeellayiya oosuwaa oottiya ashkkaraa hanqqettees.

verses.1: Liiqo haasayai hanqquwaa zarbbissees; shin porddolla qaalai hanqquwaa denttettees.
verses.2: Aadhdhida eranchchaa inxxarssai eraa puulayees; shin eeyyatu doonai eeyyatettaa xuuqqees.
verses.3: GODAA aifeti ubbasaa xeelloosona; iitaa oottiyaageetakka lo77uwaa oottiyaageetakka be7oosona.
verses.4: SHonggaara de7iya lo77o haasayai de7o mittaa mala; shin geella haasayai ayyaanaa kinchchees.
verses.5: Eeyya asi ba aawaa seeraa karees; shin ba aawaa zoriyaa ekkiya asi eranchcha.
verses.6: Xillo uraa keettan daro miishshai de7ees; shin iitaassi geliya miishshai metuwaa ehees.
verses.7: Aadhdhida eranchchatu doonai eraa zerees; shin eeyyatu wozanai hegaa mala gidenna.
verses.8: GODAI iitatu yarshshuwaa shenetees; shin suuretu woosai a ufaissees.
verses.9: GODAI iita asatu hemetaa shenetees; shin xillotettaa kaalliyaageeta i siiqees.
verses.10: Likke ogiyaa aggida asa iita boshai naagees; seeriyoogaa ixxiya asi haiqqees.
verses.11: Harai attin, duufoikka bashshaikka GODAA sinttan qoncciyan beettoosona. Yaatin, asa wozanaa qofai waani appe geemmanee?
verses.12: Qilliicciya asi seeriyoogaa dosenna; aadhdhida eranchchatuppekka zore oichchenna.
verses.13: Wozanai ufaittin, som77oi poo7ees; shin wozani azzanikko, he aawu siiddees.
verses.14: Akeekiya wozanai de7iyo asi eratettaa koyees; shin eeyyati bantta eeyyatettan ufaittoosona.
verses.15: Hiyyeesatu de7oi ubba gallassikka baaxe. SHin ufaittiya asati ubbatonkka bantta de7uwaa aloosona.
verses.16: Ooshshai de7iyo gita aquwaappe GODAA yashshatettai de7iyo guuttabai keha.
verses.17: Ooshshai de7iyoosan modhdho ashuwaa maanaappe siiqoi de7iyoosan santtaa miyoogee keha.
verses.18: Hanqqettiya asi ooshshaa kessees; shin hanqqettanau eesotenna asi ooshshaa irxxissees.
verses.19: Azalla uraassi metoi a oge ubban aguntta dirssa mala; shin suure uraa ogee badaasa.
verses.20: Eranchcha na7ai ba aawaa ufaissees; shin eeyya na7ai ba aayyiyo karees.
verses.21: Wozani bainna asi ba eeyatettan ufaittees; shin wozannaama asi likkebaa oottees.
verses.22: Zoretai xayikko, halchchidobai halettees; daro zoriyaageeti de7iyoosan halchchidobai polettees.
verses.23: Oishettidobaassi likke zaaruwaa zaariyoogee he uraa ufaissees; haasayaa likke wodiyan haasayiyoogee aiba lo77obee!
verses.24: Aadhdhida eranchchai bollau kaalettiya de7uwaa ogiyan hemetteesippe attin, duge duufuwau wottiya ogiyan hemettenna.
verses.25: GODAI otoranchchatu keettaa qolana; shin am77ee aquwaa naagees.
verses.26: GODAI iitatu qofaa shenetees; shin geeshsha qaalai a ufaissees.
verses.27: Wordduwan woriyaa demmanau jaamiya asi ba so asaa bolli metuwaa ehees; shin mattaayiyaa ixxiya asi paxa de7ana.
verses.28: Xillo asi haasayanaappe kasetidi qoppees; shin iitatu inxxarssai palabaa pulttees.
verses.29: GODAI iitatuppe haakkees; shin xillotu woosaa siyees.
verses.30: Pashkkidi xeelliyo xeelai wozanaa ufaissees; mishiraachcho odoikka bollaa pattees.
verses.31: De7uwaa immiya zoriyaa siyiya asi aadhdhida eranchchatuura issippe de7ana.
verses.32: Seeraa ixxiya asi bana qohees; shin seeraa ekkiya asi akeekaa demmees.
verses.33: GODAASSI yayyiyoogee asa aadhdhida eratettaa tamaarissees; bonchchettana koyida asi koiro bana kaushshanau koshshees.

verses.1: Asi ba wozanan halchchees; shin likke zaaroi GODAAPPE beettees.
verses.2: Asi oottiyo ooso ubbai au likke milatees; shin GODAI koiro denddo qofaa yiggi xeellees.
verses.3: Ne oottiyoobaa ubbaa hadaraa GODAAYYO imma; yaatikko, neeni halchchidobai polettana.
verses.4: GODAI medhdhidobau ubbau a wurssettai de7ees; makkalanchchatu wurssettaikka bashshaa.
verses.5: GODAI otorettiya ubbaa shenetees; eti qaxxayettennan attokkona.
verses.6: Aggenna siiquwaaninne ammanettiyoogan nagarai atto geetettees; asi GODAAYYO yayyiyoogan iitabaa oottennan naagettees.
verses.7: Asa hemeti GODAA ufaissiyaabaa gidikko, he aawu ba morkketu addiniitaarakka saro de7anaadan, GODAI oottees.
verses.8: Xillotettan beettiya guuttabai wordduwan demmiyo daro woriyaappe keha.
verses.9: Asi ba wozanan ba oottanabaa halchchees; shin halchchoi GODAI maaddin polettees.
verses.10: Kawoi Xoossaappe ekkido maatan pirddees; pirddiiddi i balenna.
verses.11: Yiggiyo meezaanatinne makkiyo miishshati ammanttiyaageeta gidanaadan, GODAI koyees; baizziyooban ubban genee de7ennaadan koyees.
verses.12: Kawoti mooro oosuwaa shenetoosona; aissi giikko, eta kawotaa araatai xillotettan eqqees.
verses.13: Kawoti xillo inxxarssan ufaittoosona; tumaa haasayiyaageetakka dosoosona.
verses.14: Kawuwaa hanqqoi haiquwaa kiitanchchaa mala; shin aadhdhida eranchcha asi hanqquwaa irxxissanau auddashees.
verses.15: Kawuwaa som77oi pashkkikko, hegee simmi de7o. I nashshiyoogee badhdheesaa iraa ehiya shaaraa mala.
verses.16: Aadhdhida eratettaa demmiyoogee worqqaa demmiyoogaappe keha; akeekaa demmiyoogee biraa demmiyoogaappekka aadhdhees.
verses.17: Suureti biyo ogee iiti de7iyoosaappe haahuwaara kanttissees; ba hemetaa naagiya uri ba shemppuwaa naagees.
verses.18: Otoruwaa geeduwaa bashshai kaallees; ayyuwaa geeduwaakka kunddettai kaallees.
verses.19: Ayyiyaageetuura zuppetidi, omooduwaa shaakki ekkanaappe ashkke gididi, hiyyeesidi de7iyoogee keha.
verses.20: GODAA qaalaa loittidi ezggiya urau i oottiyoobai ubbai injjettana; GODAN ammanettiya uri anjjettidaagaa.
verses.21: Ba qofan aadhdhida eranchcha gidida asi akeekanchcha geetettees; lo77o qaalai eratettaa gujjees.
verses.22: Cincca urau eratettai de7o pultto mala; shin eeyyata seeriyoogee coo wode wurssiyoogaa.
verses.23: Aadhdhida eranchcha asi haasayanaappe kasetidi qoppees; qoppidi asi ekkiyo haasayaa haasayees.
verses.24: Lo77o qaalai eessaa ililuwaadan mal77ees; bollaakka maaddeesinne pattees.
verses.25: Asaassi suure milatiya ogee de7ees; shin wurssettan haiquwau gattees.
verses.26: Namisainne metoi asi minnidi oottanaadan giddoosona.
verses.27: Iita asi iitabaa halchchees; a haasayaikka xuuggiya tamaa mala.
verses.28: Geella asi ooshshaa denttees; zigirssanchcha asi ammanettiya laggeta shaakkees.
verses.29: Gene asi ba shooruwaa cimmees; lo77o gidenna ogiyau i a kaalettees.
verses.30: Ba aifiyaa qim77otiya asi geellabaa qoppees; ba menttershshaa saxxidi manddiya asi iitabaa polees.
verses.31: Puulummida huuphee bonchcho kallachcha; hegeekka beettiyoi xillo de7uwaa de7iina.
verses.32: Wolqqaama asa gidiyoogaappe, hanqqettanau eesotenna asa gidiyoogee lo77o; daro katamata olidi oiqqiyoogaappe, asi ba huuphiyaa haariyoogee aadhdhees.
verses.33: Asi saamaa yeggees; shin GODAI ubbabaa battees.

verses.1: Ooshshai de7iyoosan de7iya gita gibiraappe saroinne woppai de7iyoosan mela oittaa poquwaa miyoogee keha.
verses.2: Cincca ashkkarai ba godaa na7aa pattenna laafaa haarees; yaatidi ishanttuura issippe laattees.
verses.3: Worqqainne birai taman paacettiyoogaadan, GODAI asaa wozanaa paaccees.
verses.4: Iita asi iita uraa haasayaa siyees; worddanchchaikka genanchchaa oduwaa ezggees.
verses.5: Hiyyeesatu bolli qilliicciya asi eta medhdhida Xoossaa cayees; hara asa gakkiya metuwan ufaittiya asi qaxxayettennan attenna.
verses.6: Naatu naati cimida asatuyyo kallachcha; aawati bantta naatuyyo bonchcho.
verses.7: Daro lo77o haasayai eeyya uraassi giigenna; hegaappekka aaruwaa worddo haasayai deriyaa haariyaagaassi giigenna.
verses.8: Mattaayee bana immiyaagau dumma wolqqa mala; i simmido soho ubbai ayyo injjetees.
verses.9: Naaqettidi ba naaquwaa genttiya urai siiquwaa koyees; shin yoho zaari zaaridi woociya urai, ammanettiya laggeta shaakkees.
verses.10: Eeyyai xeetuton lissuwan shocin eriyoogaappe akeeki de7iyo asi coo seerin eriyoogee aadhdhees.
verses.11: Iita asi makkalabaa xalaalaa koyees; hegaa gishshau, meqetti bainna daanni a bolli kiitettana.
verses.12: Eeyyatetti oiqqido uraara gaittiyoogaappe marata bonqqi ekkirggido maaheera gaittiyoogee keha.
verses.13: Lo77o oottidoogaa kushiyaa iitaa zaariya uraayyo iitai a sooppe mulekka kichchenna.
verses.14: Ooshshai doommiiddi, zeeruwaa xuussiya haattaa mala; hegaa gishshau, ooshshaappe kasetada palamaa aggaaga.
verses.15: Nagaranchchaa xillissiyoogeenne xilluwaa bolli pirddiyoogee eti naa77aikka GODAA sheneyiya ooso.
verses.16: Akeekiya wozani au bainnaashin, eeyyaa kushiyan aadhdhida eratettaa shammiyo miishshai aibissi de7ii?
verses.17: Laggee mule wodekka siiqees; ishaikka metuwaa wode maaddanaassi yelettees.
verses.18: Akeekai paccido asi erenna uraa acuwaa qanxxanau waase gelees.
verses.19: Ooshshaa dosiya asi nagaraa dosees; ubbatoo ceeqettiya asi bashshaa ba bolli xeesees.
verses.20: Geella qofai de7iyo asi lo77obaa demmenna; shikkaalobaa haasayiya asikka metuwan gelees.
verses.21: Azalla na7aa yelida aawi azzanees; eeyya na7aa aawau ufaissi baawa.
verses.22: Wozani ufaittiyoogee asassi lo77o xale; shin kayyottiyoogee asau wolqqaa xaissees.
verses.23: Iita daannai pirddaa geellayanau geeman mattaayiyaa ekkees.
verses.24: Akeekai de7iyo uri aadhdhida eratettaa sinttan wottidi bees; shin eeyyaa aifee biittaa sa7aa xanxxaa yuuyidi xeellees.
verses.25: Azalla na7ai ba aawaa azzanissees; bana yelida aayyiyookka zil77issees.
verses.26: Xillo asa qaxxayiyoogee, suure asakka a suuretettaa gishshau dechchiyoogee lo77o gidenna.
verses.27: Amarida qaala haasayiya asi eranchcha; woppa ayyaani de7iyo asikka akeekanchcha.
verses.28: Eeyya uri co77u giikkonne ba doonaa barikko, eranchcha milatees.

verses.1: SHaahettanau koyiya asi ba amuwaa kaallees; lo77o era ubbaakka phalqqees.
verses.2: Eeyyai ba qofaa qonccissanaagaa xalaalaa dosiyoogaappe attin, hara asappe era ekkanau dosenna.
verses.3: Iitatettai yiyo wode, karee, kaushshinne yeelli a kaallidi yi bayoosona.
verses.4: Asaa doonaappe kiyiya haasayai ciimmaa haattaa mala; aadhdhida eratettaa pulttoikka goggiya haattaa mala.
verses.5: Mooranchchaa maaddidi, xilluwaa pirddaa geellayiyoogee lo77o gidenna.
verses.6: Eeyya asi ba haasayan ooshshaa denttees; a doonaappe kiyiya qaalai a warissees.
verses.7: Eeyya asi, haasayiiddi bana qohees; a haasayai gite gididi, a oiqqees.
verses.8: Zigirssanchchaa qaalai mal77o qumaa mala; ufaissiiddi duge ganjjiyaa gakkees.
verses.9: Ba oottiyo oosuwan azalliya asi bashshiya urappe ainne dummatenna.
verses.10: GODAA sunttai mino gimbbe mala; xillo asi yaa woxxidi saro attana.
verses.11: SHin dure asatussi eta duretettai yuushoi gimbbettido katamaa mala; eta qofan eta duretettai mino dirssaadan eta naagiyaabaa milatees.
verses.12: Asi kunddanaappe kase a wozanai otorettees; bonchchettiyoogaappekka ba huuphiyaa ziqqi oottiyoogee sinttatees.
verses.13: Siyennan de7iiddi zaariyoogee, hegee he uraayyo eeyyatettanne yeella.
verses.14: Asa ayyaani harggiyaa danddayanaadan maaddees; shin ayyaani meqerettiichchikko, a ooni danddayanee?
verses.15: Akeekanchcha asati tamaaranau keehi koyoosona; aadhdhida eri de7iyoobaakka ezggoosona.
verses.16: Immiyoobi immiyaagau ogiyaa dooyees; gita asaarakka erissees.
verses.17: Kasetidi daannan mootiya uri baarigaarai yiidi a oichchana gakkanaashin, ubbatonkka he urai xillo milatees.
verses.18: Saamaa yeggiyoogee palamaa teqqees; naa77u wolqqaama baarigaaratakka shaakkees.
verses.19: Naaqettida ishaara giiganaagee gimbbettida katamaa omooddanaagaappekka aadhdhi waayissees; penggiyaa gorddiyo birata hiraquwaadan, palamai dabbota shaakkees.
verses.20: Ba doonan haasayidobaappe asi ba ganjjiyaa kunttees: ba inxxarssaappe kiyidaban kallees.
verses.21: Neeni haasayidoogee nena wottees woikko worees; hegaa gishshau, neeni ne haasayaa gaasuwan yiyaabaa ekkanau de7aasa.
verses.22: Machcho demmida asi lo77obaa demmiis; he urai GODANKKA nashettees.
verses.23: Hiyyeesa asi auddashidi haasayees; shin duree phenqqeshidi zaarees.
verses.24: Daro laggee de7iyo asi xayana; shin ishappe aadhdhidi ammanttiya laggee de7ees.

verses.1: Worddo haasayaa haasayiya eeyyaappe ba de7on boree bainna hiyyeesa asi keha.
verses.2: Eri bainna minotai lo77o gidenna; hemettiiddi eesotiya uraikka wora bees.
verses.3: Issi issi asai ba eeyyatettan ba de7uwaa bashshees; yaatidi qassi GODAA bolli yiillotees.
verses.4: Duretettai daro laggeta gujjees; shin hiyyeesatettai de7iya laggetakka duuttees.
verses.5: Worddo markki qaxxayettennan beenna; wordduwaa haasayiyaageetikka kessi ekkokkona.
verses.6: Daro asai daannaa sinttaa koyees; coo immiya uraara asi ubbi dabbotees.
verses.7: Hiyyeesa asa a ishantti ubbai ixxoosona; hegaappekka aaruwaa a laggeti appe haakkoosona; i eta auddashidi kaallinkka, eti a gatti oittokkona.
verses.8: Aadhdhida eratettaa demmiyaagee bana siiqees; akeekaa qoraphphiyaagee lo77obaa demmees.
verses.9: Worddo markki qaxxayettennan attenna; wordduwaa haasayiyaageekka xayana.
verses.10: Azalla uraassi ishalo de7oi bessenna; hegaappekka aillee halaqata haariyoogee iitaa darees.
verses.11: Aawussi de7iya aadhdhida eratettai hanqquwaa mitissees; moorida urau atto giyoogeekka bonchchissees.
verses.12: Kawuwaa hanqqoi gaammuwaa gudettaa mala; shin a nashettai maataa aacissiya akkaa mala.
verses.13: Eeyya na7ai ba aawaa xaissees; ooshshanchcha machchiyaakka keetti ubbaton aattiyo aato mala.
verses.14: Issi asi keettaanne aquwaa ba aawaappe laattanau danddayees; shin akeekanchcha machchiyo GODAI immees.
verses.15: Coo zolppattiya uraayyo xiskkoi yees; ooso oottenna asi namisettees.
verses.16: Azazuwaa naagidi oottiya asi, ba shemppuwaa naagees; shin shenehoo giya asi haiqqees.
verses.17: Hiyyeesaassi kehiya asi GODAASSI tal77ees; GODAI he lo77o oosuwaa acuwaa qanxxees.
verses.18: Simmiyo menttoi de7ishin, ne naata seera; seerana xayikko, neeni eta bashshadasa.
verses.19: Hanqquwaa suulliya asi ba waagaa ekko; a aggaaga; neeni a ashshiyaabaa gidikko, haranttuwaakka neeni a hegaadan oottanaagee attenna.
verses.20: Zoriyaa siya; timirttiyaakka ekka. Yaatikko, neeni wurssettan aadhdhida eranchcha gidana.
verses.21: Asai darobaa halchchees; shin GODAI giidobai polettees.
verses.22: Asappe koyettiyaagee aggenna siiquwaa; worddanchcha gidanaappe hiyyeesa gidiyoogee keha.
verses.23: GODAASSI yayyiyoogee de7uwau kaalettees; assi yayyiya asi kallidi de7ees; iitabikka a bochchenna.
verses.24: Issi issi asai daro azalla; woxiyan tushkkido buddeenaakka pude baaranau waayettees.
verses.25: Neeni qilliicciyaagaa shocikko, akeekai paccidoogee cinccatettaa tamaarana; akeekanchcha asa neeni seerikko, i eratettaa demmana.
verses.26: Ba aawaa bonqqiya na7ai, ba aayyiyookka sooppe kessidi yedettiya na7ai, he na7ai yeellaanne kaushshaa ehiya na7a.
verses.27: Ta na7au, neeni zoriyaa siyiyoogaa aggidabaa gidikko, erau zokkuwaa zaaradasa.
verses.28: Worddo markkai suure pirddaa bolli qilliiccees; iita asaa doonai iitatettaa gubbidi mittees.

verses.1: Daro mattoyiya ushshaa uyiyoogee daro bidisseesinne ooshshees; mattottiya asi wozani paccido asa.
verses.2: Kawo hanqqoi gaammuwaa gudettaa mala; a yiilloyiya asi ba shemppuwaa bolli pirddees.
verses.3: Palamaappe gaxan de7iyoogee aawussi bonchcho; shin eeyya asi ubbi ooyettanau eesotees.
verses.4: Azalla goshshanchchai wodiyaa naagidi goyenna; hegaa gishshau, kattaa cakkiyo wode i woossees; shin aibakka demmenna.
verses.5: Asaa wozanaa halchchoi ciimma ollaa giddon de7iya haattaa mala; shin wozannaama asi hegaa duuqqidi kessees.
verses.6: Daro asati bantta kehatettaa yootoosona; shin tumu ammanettiya asa demmanai oonee?
verses.7: Xillo asi boree bainna de7uwaa de7ees; a kaallidi, a naatikka anjjettidaageeta.
verses.8: Kawoi pirddanau ba kawotaa araatan uttido wode, iita ubbaa ba aifiyan harqqidi kessees.
verses.9: “Ta wozanaa geeshshaas; tanan nagarikka baawa” yaaganau danddayiya asi de7aneeshsha?
verses.10: GODAI worddo meezaanan yiggiyaageetanne likke gidennaban makkiyaageeta ixxees.
verses.11: Na7i geeshshanne suure gidiyoogee i oottiyo oosuwan erettees.
verses.12: Siyiya haittaanne xeelliya aifiyaanne, eta naa77aakka GODAI medhdhiis.
verses.13: Xiskkon ne wodiyaa wurssoppa; wurssikko neeni hiyyeesana. Beegotta; yaatikko, neeni kattaa kallana.
verses.14: SHammiya asi, “Qohees! Qohees!” yaagees; shin biidoogaappe guyyiyan, “Hiraisuwan shammaas” yaagiiddi ceeqettees.
verses.15: Erai kumido haasayai worqqaappekka inqquwaa giyo daro al77o shuchchaappekka aadhdhida al77obaa.
verses.16: Erenna asau waase geliya uraa maayuwaa qaari ekkite; imatta asau waase geliya uraa maayuwaa oiqqite.
verses.17: Wordduwan demmido kattai asa mal77ees; shin aqi kiyiiddi, doonaa giddon shaahetaadan hanees.
verses.18: Zoriyaa ekkada ne halchchiyoobaa halchcha; zore ekkennan de7aidda olau booppa.
verses.19: Zigirssanchcha asi xuuraa genttenna; hegaa gishshau, odanchcha uraara gaittoppa.
verses.20: Asi ba aawaa woikko ba aayyiyo cayikko, a de7uwaa xomppe sakkana xuman to7ana.
verses.21: Koiroora eesuwan shiiqida aqoi wurssettan anjjettenna.
verses.22: Neeyyo iitaa oottida urau, taanikka ayyo iitaa oottana gooppa; GODAN ammanettada naaga; i nena ashshana.
verses.23: GODAI naa77u qommo meezaanata shenetees; worddo meezaanatikka a ufaissokkona.
verses.24: Asai baanau bessiya ogiyaa GODAI kaalettees; yaatin, asi ba de7uwan baana ogiyaa waatidi akeekanau danddayii?
verses.25: Issibaa eesotidi, “Hagaa taani Xoossaassi immaas” girggiyoogeenne guyyeppe zil77ettiyoogee, hegee asa oiqqiya pire.
verses.26: Aadhdhida eranchcha kawoi makkalanchchata shaakkidi erees; i etau qarettennan qaxxayees.
verses.27: Asaa ayyaanai GODAAYYO xomppe; hegaa gishshau, i nu giddo asatetta ubbaa pilggi xeellees.
verses.28: Aggenna siiqoinne ammanettiyoogee kawuwaa naagoosona; a kawotaa araatai aggenna siiquwan minnees.
verses.29: Yelagatu bonchchoi eta wolqqaa; cimatuyyookka eta puulunttai etau bonchcho.
verses.30: Mino qixaatee iitatettaa shoddees; wadhdhiyoogee iita wozanaa laammanau danddayees.

verses.1: Kawuwaa wozanai GODAA kushiyaana; i a wozanaa goggiya haattaa zaariyoogaadan, ba koyidosaa zaarees.
verses.2: Asi oottiyoobai ubbai aawussi likke milatees; shin GODAI a wozanaa qofaa paaccees.
verses.3: Yarshshuwaa yarshshiyoogaappekka aattidi, xillobaanne suurebaa oottiyoogaa GODAI dosees.
verses.4: Iitati otorettiyoogaaninne ayyiyoogan erettoosona; hegeekka nagara.
verses.5: Mino oosanchchaa halchchoi dureyees; shin eesotiya ubbai hiyyeesana.
verses.6: Worddotidi dagayido aqoi penttuwaa suuluwaadan xayees; hegaa koyiyaageeti haiquwaa koyoosona.
verses.7: Iitati suurebaa oottanau ixxiyo gishshau, eta makkala oosoi eta ekkidi bees.
verses.8: Mooranchchati geella ogiyan hemettoosona; shin geeshshati suurebaa oottoosona.
verses.9: Ooyettiya machcheera issi keettan de7iyoogaappe he keettaa shakkuwan de7iyoogee keha.
verses.10: Iitati iitabaa oottanau amottoosona; bantta shoorotussi qarettokkona.
verses.11: Qilliicciyaagee qaxxayettido wode, wozani paccido urai aadhdhida eraa tamaarees; qassi wozannaama urai tamaaridi, eraa demmees.
verses.12: Xillo Xoossai iitatu son oosettiyaabaa ubbaa be7ees; eta aatti yeggidi xaissees.
verses.13: Hiyyeesaa waasuwaa siyanaappe giidi, ba haittaa tucciya uri, ikka waassana; waassin alliyaabai xayana.
verses.14: Geeman immiyo imoi hanqquwaa doshissees. Afala giddoora immido mattaayee suulo hanqquwaa irxxissees.
verses.15: Suure pirddai pirddettido wode, hegee xilluwaassi ufaissa; shin iitaa oottiyaageetussi dagama.
verses.16: Akeeka ogiyaappe haddirida uraa haiqoi naagees.
verses.17: Aaro injjiyan de7ana giya urai manqqees; woine eessanne zaite dosiya asi duretenna.
verses.18: Issi issiton Xoossaasata ashshanau iita asati qaxxayettoosona; ammanettenna asatikka suure asatu gishshaa qaxxayettoosona.
verses.19: Ooyettiyanne yiillotiya machcheera de7anaappe bazzon de7iyoogee keha.
verses.20: Wozannaama uraa son mal77o qumainne oissai minjjettees; shin eeyya asi bau de7iyaabaa ubbaa mirggees.
verses.21: Xillotettaanne aggenna siiquwaa koyiya uraa baree aduqqees; qassi he urai xillotettaanne bonchchuwaa demmees.
verses.22: Wozannaama asi wolqqaama olanchchati de7iyo katamaa olidi oiqqees; oiqqidi eti ammanettido mino qatuwaakka laalees.
verses.23: Ba doonaanne ba inxxarssaa naagiya asi bana metuwaappe naagees.
verses.24: Otorettiyanne ayyiya asi qilliicciyaagaa geetettees; i otoranchcha gidido gishshau, asau qoppenna.
verses.25: Azallaa amoi worees; aissi giikko, i oottanau koyenna.
verses.26: Azallai gallassa kumettaa darobaa demmanau amottees; shin xilloi bau ashshennan immees.
verses.27: GODAI iitatu yarshshuwaa shenetees; hegaappekka eti au iita qofan shiishshiyo yarshshuwaa aatti shenetees.
verses.28: Worddo markkai xayana; shin qoppidi akeekan haasayiya uraa haasayai ehettana.
verses.29: Iita asi taagaa xalaalai likke gees; shin suure asi yuushshi qoppees.
verses.30: Asi ba aadhdhida eratettan, akeekaaninne zoriyan GODAARA eqettanau danddayenna.
verses.31: Olaayyo paraa kooranau danddayettees; shin olaa xoonissiyaagee GODAA.

verses.1: Lo77o sunttai daro duretettaappe aadhdhees; sabettiyoogeekka biraappenne worqqaappe aadhdhees.
verses.2: Duriyaanne manqquwaa ubbaakka GODAI medhdhiis; hegan eti naa77aikka lagge.
verses.3: Cincca asi iitaa be7idi, qosetti aattees; shin akeeki paccido asi metuwan gelidi qohettees.
verses.4: Neeni ashkke gidikkonne GODAASSI yayyikko, duretettaa, bonchchuwaanne de7uwaa demmana.
verses.5: Iita uraa ogiyan agunttainne piree de7ees; shin bana naagiya asi etappe haakkees.
verses.6: Na7i waanidi de7ana bessiyaakko tamaarissa; yaatikko, i cimidikka hegaa aggenna.
verses.7: Duree hiyyeesaa haarees; tal77i ekkidaagee tal77iyau immidaagau aille gidees.
verses.8: Nagaraa zeriya urai waayiyaa cakkees; harata i tuggayiyo tuggaikka attees.
verses.9: Keha asi ba qumaappe hiyyeesau coo immiyo gishshau anjjettana.
verses.10: Qilliicciya asa diggarggikko, palamai, ooshshainne cashshai kichchana.
verses.11: Neeni wozanaa geeshshatettaanne keha haasayaa dosikko, kawoi nenaara dabbotees.
verses.12: GODAI tumaa naagees; shin worddanchchatu qaalaa i aatti yeggees.
verses.13: Azalla asi, “Taani kare kiyikko, gaammoi tana maana; tana ogiyan asi worana” yaagees.
verses.14: SHaaramuxa maccaasee doonai ciimma ollaa mala; GODAI hanqqettido uri a giddon kunddees.
verses.15: Na7a wozanaa azallatettai baqqi oiqqees; shin qaixaariyan qaxxayiyoogee appe haassees.
verses.16: Baayyo aquwaa gujjana giidi, hiyyeesaa naaqqiyaageenne duriyaassi imuwaa immiyaagee naa77aikka hiyyeesana.
verses.17: Ne haittaa haa yeggada, aadhdhida eranchchai odiyoobaa siya; ne wozanaakka ta eraakko zaara.
verses.18: Aissi giikko, eta ne wozanan wottikkonne ne doonankka eta ubbaa hassayikko, neeni ufaittana.
verses.19: Ne ammanoi GODAN gidana mala, taani nena - ee nena - hachchi tamaarissaas.
verses.20: Taani neessi zoreenne eratettai de7iyo hasttamu leemisota xaafoohoo!
verses.21: Nena kiittidaagaayyo neeni likke zaaruwaa zaarana mala, taani nena tumatettaa tamaarissaas.
verses.22: Hiyyeesatussi aibinne bainna gishshau, etabaa bonqqoppa; shilootankka metootanchchatu maataa xaissoppa.
verses.23: Aissi giikko, GODAI eta gishshaa mootettana; eta bonqqidaageetakka i bonqqana.
verses.24: Hanqqettiya uraara laggetoppa; hanqqettanau eesotiya uraarakka zuppetoppa.
verses.25: Neeni a hanuwaa meezetikko, guyyeppe agganau danddayakka.
verses.26: Asassi aco ta qanxxana gaada waase geloppa.
verses.27: Neeni qanxxiyoobi xayikko, ne zin77iyo hiixai attennan, neessi de7iyaabai ubbai ekettana.
verses.28: Ne maizza aawati tokkido beni zawaa shoddoppa.
verses.29: Ba oosuwaa cinccatettan oottiya asa be7adii? I kawotussi ootteesippe attin, coo asatussi oottenna.

verses.1: Neeni deriyaa haariyaagaara qumaa maanau uttido wode, ne sinttan de7iyaagaa loittada akeeka.
verses.2: Neeni daro yora asa gidikko, naagetta.
verses.3: I nena paaccanau danddayiyo gishshau, aadhdhida mal77o qumau yiiqetoppa.
verses.4: Duretanau daafuroppa; hegaa mala keesiyaa agganau cincca gida.
verses.5: Hegaa mala duretettai neeni xeellishin xayana; qefiyaa kessidi argganttaagaadan, saluwaa paallana.
verses.6: Uuziyaa qumaa mooppa; a mal77o qumaakka maanau amottoppa.
verses.7: Milatissanau i nena, “Ma; uya” yaageesippe attin, a wozanai nenaara de7enna.
verses.8: Neeni miido qiiba qumaa cooyana; ne galataikka hada gidana.
verses.9: Eeyyaassi payyabaa haasayoppa; aissi giikko, ne aadhdhida era haasayaa i karana.
verses.10: Beni zawaa shoddoppa; qassi aawi bainna naatu gadiyaa zawaa sugoppa;
verses.11: aissi giikko, eta ashshiya GODAI mino; i eta gishshaa nenaara mootettana.
verses.12: Ne asttamaaree neessi odiyoogaa ezgga; ne haittaakka eraa qaalaakko yegga.
verses.13: Na7a seerennan aggoppa; neeni a qaixaariyan wadhdhikko, i haiqqenna.
verses.14: Neeni a qaixaariyan wadhdhikko, a shemppuwaa haiquwaappe ashshaasa.
verses.15: Ta na7au, neeni aadhdhida eranchcha gidikko, ta wozanaikka ufaittana;
verses.16: ne inxxarssai suurebaa haasayiyo wode, ta wozanai ufaittees.
verses.17: Nagaranchchata qanaatoppa; shin ubbatoo GODAASSI yayyiyoogaa aggoppa.
verses.18: Yaanikko neeyyo sinttanau sa7i kehana; sinttappe yaana kehikka neeyyo xayenna.
verses.19: Ta na7au, siya; wozannaama gida; ne wozanaa suure ogiyan wotta.
verses.20: Daro woine eessaa uyiyaageetuuranne ashuwaa muussau yaaretiyaageetuura zuppetoppa;
verses.21: aissi giikko, mattottiyaageetinne yoranchchati manqqana; xiskkuwaa daroi asaa wurida curqqaa maizissees.
verses.22: Nena yelida ne aawai odiyoobaa siya; ne aayyiyaakka ceeggido wode karoppa.
verses.23: Tumaa, aadhdhida eratettaa, timirttiyaanne akeekaa shammappe attin, mulekka baizzoppa.
verses.24: Xillo na7aa aawai keehippe ufaittana; wozannaama na7aa yelida urikka an poccu gaana.
verses.25: Ne aawainne ne aayyiyaa ufaittona; nena yelidaarakka poccu gu.
verses.26: Ta na7au, ta zoriyaa ezgga; taani haniyoogaadan hana.
verses.27: Aissi giikko, shaaramuxiya maccaasiyaa ciimma ollaa mala; laggettuwaa oiqqiya machchiyaakka un77o ollaa mala.
verses.28: A panggadan zuggada naagausu; ammanettenna attumaasaa asaa giddon darissausu.
verses.29: “Woo!” giyo waasoi oossee? Azzanoi oossee? Ooshshi oossee? Zuuzuntti oossee? Gaasoi bainnan masunxxiyai oonee? Aifee zo77iyoi oossee?
verses.30: Woine eessaa uyiiddi gam77iyaageetussa gidennee? Walahettida woine eessaa uyi uyi be7iyaageetussa gidennee?
verses.31: Woine eessai zo77ido wode, a merai birilliyaa giddon phooliyo wode, uyishin yalalattiiddi geliyo wode, a xeelloppa.
verses.32: Wurssettan i shooshshadan dukkees; mulumuqqe shooshshadankka ba yiishshaa yiishshees.
verses.33: Ne aifee be7i erennabaa be7ana; ne wozanaikka suure qoppanaunne haasayanau danddayenna.
verses.34: Neeni abbaa giddon dambbalai qaattiyo markkabiyaa xeeran zin77ida uraa mala gidana.
verses.35: Neeni, “Eti tana dechchidosona; shin taani qohettabeikke. Eti tana wadhdhidosona; shin tau erettibeenna. Hara ushshaa uyanau taani aude denddanddinaashsha?” yaagana.

verses.1: Ta na7au, iita asatu mala gidarkkinaashsha gooppa; etaara dabbotanaukka amottoppa;
verses.2: aissi giikko, eti ubbatoo makkalabaa maqettoosona; bantta inxxarssan genebaa haasayoosona.
verses.3: Keettai aadhdhida eratettan keexettees; akeekankka minnees.
verses.4: Erai de7ikko, qol77oi al77obaaninne lo77oban ubban kumees.
verses.5: Wozannaama urau gita wolqqai de7ees; eranchcha asikka minotettaa gujjees.
verses.6: Neeni olau kiyanaappe kasetada halchchuwaa halchchana koshshees; daro zoriyaageetu zoriyan xoonoi beettees.
verses.7: Eeyyai aadhdhida eratettaa akeekanau danddayenna; au yaa7ankka odiyoobi aibinne baawa.
verses.8: Iitaa oottanau halchchiya urai genanchcha geetettana.
verses.9: Eeyyatettaa qofai nagara; asai qilliicciyaagaa ixxees.
verses.10: Neeni metuwaa gallassi laafikko, ne wolqqai guutta giyoogaa.
verses.11: Haiqqanau bessennan, haiquwau pirddidi efiyoogeeta ashsha; worana haniyo wode co77u gaada xeelloppa.
verses.12: Neeni, “Nuuni hagaa eribookko” yaagikko, wozanaa eriyaagee i be7ennee? Ne de7uwaa naagiyaagee erennee? Asa ubbau a oosuwaa oosuwaadan zaarennee?
verses.13: Ta na7au, eessaa ma; eessai lo77o. Eessaa ililoi manggaagan mal77ees.
verses.14: Aadhdhida eratettaikka hegaa mala; i ne shemppuwau mal77o gidiyoogaa era. Neeni a demmiyaabaa gidikko, sinttaara yaana kehai neessa; neeni ekkana gaada ufaissan naagiyoobaikka xayenna.
verses.15: Xilluwaa keettaanne aquwaa bonqqanau qoppiya iita asadan hanoppa.
verses.16: Xillo asi laapputoo kunddikkokka denddees; shin iitati metuwan xayana.
verses.17: Ne morkkee kunddiyo wode ufaittoppa; i xubettiyo wodekka, “Hashshu!” gooppa.
verses.18: Neeni ufaittikko, GODAI hegaa be7idi ufaittenna; a hanqqettiyoogaakka aggiigana.
verses.19: Iitaa oottiyaageetu gishshau hirggoppa; eta mala gidarkkinaashsha gooppa.
verses.20: Aissi giikko, iita urau sinttaara yaana kehi baawa; iitatu xomppeekka to7ana.
verses.21: Ta na7au, GODAAYYOONNE kawuwaayyo yayya; etayyo makkaliyaageetuurakka zuppetoppa.
verses.22: Aissi giikko, hegaa mala asata qoppenna metoi gakkees; kawuwaappenne GODAAPPE yaana metuwaa oonee eriyai?
verses.23: Aadhdhida eranchchati gujjidikka hagaadan yaagidosona: Pirddiiddi maaddiyoogee lo77o gidenna.
verses.24: Mooranchchaa, “Neeni moorabaakka” yaagiya daannaa asai qanggana; kawotettatikka a ixxana.
verses.25: Mooranchchaa qaxxayiyaageeti keehi nashettananne anjjettana.
verses.26: Suure zaaruwaa zaariyoogee dabbotau malaata mala.
verses.27: Kasetada ne gadiyaa ootta; kattaakka zera; hegaappe guyyiyan, ne keettaa keexxa.
verses.28: Ne shooruwaa bolli gaasoi bainnan markkattoppa; ne doonankka cimmoppa.
verses.29: “I tau oottidoogaadan, taani au oottana; taani au a oosuwaa kushiyaa zaarana” yaagoppa.
verses.30: Taani issi gallassi, issi azallanne akeekai paccido bitaniyaa gaden de7iya woiniyaa turaa giddoora kanttaas.
verses.31: Kanttiyo wode, agunttainne sharafai goozi wottiis; yuushuwan de7iya shuchchaa gimbbeekka qolettiichchiis.
verses.32: Taani a be7ido wode, qoppaas; taani be7idoogaappe timirttiyaa tamaaraas.
verses.33: Neeni guuttaa liphphi ga; guuttaa xiskka; ne kushiyaakka shiishshada guuttaa shemppa ekka.
verses.34: Hegaappe guyyiyan, hiyyeesatettai panggadan yaana; pacaikka ola miishshaa oiqqida asadan puttu gaana.

verses.1: Hageetikka qassi, Yihudaa Kawuwaa Hizqqiyaasa asati duuqqidi xaafido Solomona leemisota.
verses.2: Xuuraa genttiyoogee Xoossaayyo bonchcho; xuuraa pilggidi kessiyoogee qassi kawotuyyo bonchcho.
verses.3: Salotu xoqqatettaanne sa7aa ciimmatettaa asi gakkennaagaadan, kawotu qofaakka asi eranau danddayenna.
verses.4: Biraappe shiyaa diggargga; hegaappe guyyiyan, wogaacee qoxxidi, lo77obaa kessana.
verses.5: Kawuwaa sinttappe iitata diggargga; yaatikko, a kawotaa araatai xillotettan minni eqqana.
verses.6: Kawuwaa sintti aadhdhiyo wode ceeqettoppa; gita asatuppe gidduwan soho koyoppa.
verses.7: Neeppe gitatiya asassi sohuwaa immanau halaqai nena denttin kauyyiyoogaappe, halaqai nena, “Hagaakko xoqqu ga” giyoogee neeyyo keha.
verses.8: Ne aifiyan be7idobaa markkattanau dabaabaa baanau eesotoppa; aissi giikko, neeni markkatta simmin, hara asi ne markkatettai bala gidiyoogaa qonccissikko, neeni yeellatana.
verses.9: Neeppenne ne shooruwaappe gidduwan palami merettikko, aara haasayada ne palamaa wurssa. Hara asa xuuraa qonccissoppa.
verses.10: Hegee xayikko, neeni odiyoogaa siyida asi nena kaushshana; hegan ne sunttai naa77antto simmennaadan moorettana.
verses.11: Koshshiyo wodiyan haasayettida likke qaalai biraa bolli tigido worqqaa alleequwaa mala.
verses.12: Ezggiya uraa eranchcha asi zoriyo zoree haittan wottido worqqaa woikko geeshsha worqqaappe oottido alleequwaa mala.
verses.13: Kattaa cakkiyo boniyan irxxa haattai uyin aliyoogaadan, kiittin ammanettiya asi bana kiittiyaageeta ufaissees.
verses.14: Immennabaa “Immana” yaagiiddi ceeqettiya asi iri bainna shaaraanne carkkuwaa mala.
verses.15: Danddayanchcha asi deriyaa haariyaagau odidi maizzees; liiqo qaalai meqettaa kanttidi gelees.
verses.16: Eessaa demmikko, kallana gakkanaashin ma; shin darissikko, neeni cooyana.
verses.17: Nena uufidi ixxennaadan, ne shooruwaa soo ubbaton booppa.
verses.18: Ba shooruwaa bolli wordduwan markkattiya asi dullai, bisoinne qara zubbee asa qohiyoogaa keenaa qohees.
verses.19: Metuwaa wode ammanettenna uran zemppiyoogee qaaxxiya achchan coommiyoogaanne silida tohuwan hemettiyoogaa mala.
verses.20: Azzani uttida asassi yettaa yexxiyoogee meego gallassi maayuwaa qaariyoogaanne masunttaa bolli caalabaa tigiyoobaa mala.
verses.21: Ne morkkee namisettikko, miza; saamettikko, ushsha.
verses.22: Aissi giikko, neeni hegaa oottiyoogee a huuphiyan tamaa bonqquwaa kaashidi qoliyoogaa mala. GODAIKKA neeyyo woitana.
verses.23: Huuphessa bagga carkkoi iraa ehiyoogaadan, zigirssai hanqquwaa ehees.
verses.24: Ooyettiya maccaaseera issi keettan de7anaappe son shakkuwaa huuphiyan de7iyoogee keha.
verses.25: Daafurida uri irxxa haattaa uyidi aliyoogaadan, haaho biittaappe yiya lo77o odoi ufaissees.
verses.26: Iita uraa eeshshaa tamaariya xillo asi bulqqotida pulttuwaanne moorettida olla haattaa mala.
verses.27: Daro eessaa miyoogee lo77o gidenna; hegaadankka, ba bonchcho koyiyoogee bonchchissenna.
verses.28: Ba huuphiyaa naagenna asi dirssai meqqido katamaa mala.

verses.1: Boniyan shachchai, kattaa cakkiyo wodiyankka irai koshshennaagaadan, eeyyau bonchchoi koshshenna.
verses.2: Kafoti yaanne haanne paallidi, asa qohennaagaadan, gaasoi bainnan qanggiyo qanggetti asa gakkenna.
verses.3: Parau lissuwaa, hariyau poxooruwaa koshshiyoogaadan, azallaa zokkuwau waraa koshshees.
verses.4: Eeyya urau a eeyyatettaadan zaaroppa; zaarikko neenikka a mala gidana.
verses.5: Eeyya urau a eeyyatettaadan zaara; hinna xayikko, i bana eranchchadan qoodana.
verses.6: Eeyya asa bolli kiitaa kiittiyoogee ba tohuwaa qanxxiyoogaanne woriyaabaa uyiyoogaa mala.
verses.7: Eeyya uraa leemisoi wobbe uraa tohuwaa mala maaddenna.
verses.8: Eeyya uraa bonchchiya asi shuchchaa yambbarshshaa bolli qachchi wottidi yambbariya asa mala.
verses.9: Eeyya uraa leemisoi mattottida asi ba kushiyaa caddida agunttaa kessanau baaxetiyoogaa mala.
verses.10: Eeyya asa woikko bau ogiyaara kanttiya asa oosossi qaxariya asi demmido asa ubbaa coo dukkiya wonddafiyaasa mala.
verses.11: Kanai ba cooshshaa guyye simmidi miyoogaadan, eeyyai ba eeyyatettaa oosuwaa zaari zaari oottees.
verses.12: Barkka bana, “Taani aadhdhida eranchchaa” giya asa be7adii? Appe eeyya urau sinttanaa lo77o qaadai de7ees.
verses.13: Azallai, “Ogiyan gaammoi de7ees; yashshiya gaammoi aaho ogiyan yuuyees” yaagees.
verses.14: Penggee ba maaxafiyan yaanne haanne qaaxxiyoogaadan, azallaikka ba hiixan yaanne haanne aadhdhi wodhdhees.
verses.15: Issi issi asati daro azalla; eti harai attin, woxiyan tushkkido buddeenaakka pude baaranau daafuroosona.
verses.16: Azalla asi markkaara odiya laappun eranchchatuppekka bana aadhdhida eranchcha giidi qoppees.
verses.17: Bana gattiyaabi bainnasan palamau aadhdhiya asi ogiyaara biya kanaa haittaa oiqqiya asa mala.
verses.18: Ba shooruwaa cimmidi, “Taani kaassau oottaas” yaagiya asi, gooyidi tamaa xiifaa oliya, woikko woriya zubbiyaa dukkiya asa mala.
verses.20: Mittai wurikko, tamai to7ees; zigiriyaabi xayikko, ooshshai attees.
verses.21: Xiixinttai bonqquwaa darissiyoogaadaaninne mittai tamaa darissiyoogaadan, amalanchcha asi ooshshaa darissees.
verses.22: Zigirssanchchaa qaalai mal77o qumaa mala; ufaissiiddi duge ganjjiyaa gakkees.
verses.23: Wozanan iitabai de7ishin, ba inxxarssan cimo qaalaa haasayiya asi biran sheeshshido urqqa miishshaa mala.
verses.24: Lo77o milatiya iita asi ba wozanan de7iya iitatettaa ba nasho haasayan genttees.
verses.25: A wozanan laappun tunatettai kumi uttido gishshau, i lo77o qaalaa haasayikkokka a ammanoppa.
verses.26: Ba morkketettaa i genttikkokka, i oottiyo iitatettai yaa7an qonccana.
verses.27: Haratussi ollaa bookkiya uri he ollan bau kunddana; haratu bolli shuchchaa gonddorssiya uraa bolli he shuchchai simmidi gonddorettana.
verses.28: Worddotiya inxxarssai ba qohido asata ixxees; sheleeshsho haasayai bashshaa ehaanaappe attin, harabaa eheenna.

verses.1: Wonttoban ceeqettoppa; wonttoi ehaanabaa neeni erakka.
verses.2: Nena hara asi galatoppe attin, neeni nena nerkka galatoppa; asai ne gishshaa markkattoppe attin, neeni ne kehatettaa odoppa.
verses.3: SHuchchai gita tooho; shaahetaa tookkiyoogeekka deexo; shin eeyya urai denttiyo ooshshai eta naa77aappekka deexxees.
verses.4: Hanqqossi qareti baawa; yiilloikka bashshiya di7o mala; shin qanaatiyan ubba gattoppo.
verses.5: Geemmida siiquwaappe baliyo wode qoncciyan seeriyoogee keha.
verses.6: Morkkee nena darotoo yeriyoogaappe siiqoi nena dechchiyoogee keha.
verses.7: Kallida uraa eessaa ililoi iitees; shin namisettida uraa cammiyaabaikka mal77ees.
verses.8: Ba soo aggidi yuuyiya asi, ba keettaappe haakkada paalliya kafee mala.
verses.9: SHittoinne sawiya ixaani asaa ufaissiyoogaadan, siiqo laggiyaa zoreekka ufaissees.
verses.10: Ne siiqo laggiyaanne ne aawaa siiqo laggiyaa aggoppa; nena metido wode ne ishaa soo booppa. Haahuwan de7iya ishaappe matan de7iya shooroi keha.
verses.11: Ta na7au, neeni aadhdhida eranchcha gida. Yaatiyaakko taani ufaittananne tana boriyaageetu oishaakka zaarana.
verses.12: Cincca asi metoi yiyo wode be7idi qosettees; shin akeekai paccido asi sitti gi biidi, metuwan gelees; yaatidi guyyeppe wai ana gees.
verses.13: Erenna asau waase geliya uraa maayuwaa qaari ekkite; imatta asau, waase gelida uraa maayuwaa oiqqite.
verses.14: Maallado guuran ba qaalaa xoqqu oottidi, ba shooruwaa sarotiyoogee a qanggiyoogaa mala.
verses.15: Walassada duuxxenna machchiyaanne irai bukkin xokkidi aggenna aatoi issi mala.
verses.16: Carkko teqqanau woikko zaite cuccumidi oiqqanau danddayettennaagaadan, o co77u oottanau danddayettenna.
verses.17: Biratai birataa poshiyoogaadan, asai issoi issuwaappe tamaarees.
verses.18: Balase giyo mittiyo ishalissidi naagida uri i aifiyaa maana; bana aissidaagaa kabboyiya ashkkarai bonchchettana.
verses.19: Haattai heregaadan som77uwaa bessiyoogaadan, aawu wozanai aawu eeshshaa bessees.
verses.20: Haiqoinne bashshi kalli erokkona; hegaadankka, asa amoi kallenna.
verses.21: Birainne worqqai taman paacettidi geeyiyoogaadan, asikka ba ekkiyo galatan paacettees.
verses.22: Eeyya asa kattaara udulan yeggada, udula mittan caddiyaakko, appe eeyyatettai kichchenna.
verses.23: Ne dorssati de7iyo hanotaa loittada era; ne mehiyaa wudiyaakka wozanappe heemma.
verses.24: Aissi giikko, duretettai merinau de7enna; kallachchaikka yeletaappe yeletau aadhdhennan agganau danddayees.
verses.25: Mela maatai buucettidoogaappe, aaca maatai kiyidoogaappenne deriyaa bollan de7iya maatai shiiqidoogaappe guyyiyan,
verses.26: dorssatu ikisiyaappe neeni neeyyo maayiyoobaa kessana; deeshshata baizzido birankka neeyyo gadiyaa shammana.
verses.27: Attiya deeshshatu maattai neessi, ne so asaassinne ne macca ashkkaratussi quma gidana.

verses.1: Iitati ooninne yedettennan baqatoosona; shin xilloti gaammo mala xala.
verses.2: Issi kawotettai nagaranchcha gidikko, a haariyaageeti laametti laamettidi haaroosona. SHin kaalettiyaageeti aadhdhida eranchchanne akeekanchcha gidiyo wode, mino gididi, daro wodiyaa takkees.
verses.3: Hiyyeesata huqqunniya hiyyeesa daannai kattaa xaissiya wolqqaama iraa mala.
verses.4: Higgiyaa bonchchenna urai mooranchchaa sabbees; shin higgiyaa bonchchiyaagee mooranchchatu qofaa phalqqees.
verses.5: Iita asatussi suure pirddaabai gelenna; shin GODAASSI goinniyaageetussi ubbabaikka gelees.
verses.6: Geella asa gididi, dure gidiyoogaappe suure asa gididi, hiyyeesa gidiyoogee keha.
verses.7: Higgiyaa naagiya wodallai akeekanchcha. SHin pattenna shufurotuura zuppetiyaagee ba aawaa yeellayees.
verses.8: Miishshaa dichchau immiyoogaaninne bonqqiyoogan duretiya asi he aquwaa hiyyeesatussi kehiya asassi shiishshees.
verses.9: Higgiyaa siyanaappe giidi, ba haittaa wora zaariya uraa woosai GODAA sheneyiyaabaa.
verses.10: Suureta iita ogiyaa kaalettiya uri ba bookkido ollan bau kunddana; shin geeshsha asi lo77obaa laattana.
verses.11: Dure asi bana aadhdhida eranchcha giidi qoppees; shin akeekai de7iyo hiyyeesai a paaccees.
verses.12: Xilloti xoonido wode, asai ubbai ufaittees; shin iitati maataa oiqqido wode, asai qosettees.
verses.13: Ba nagaraa genttiya uri aacenna; shin paaxiyaageenne nagaraa aggiyaagee maarettana.
verses.14: GODAAYYO ubbatoo yayyiya asi anjjettidaagaa; shin ba wozanaa dammissiya asi meton gelana.
verses.15: Hiyyeesa asaa haariya iita daannai gudiya gaammuwaanne namisettida godariyaa mala.
verses.16: Wozani paccido daannai ba asaa naaqqees; shin asa naaqqiyoogaa ixxiyaagee daro laittaa haarana.
verses.17: Asa worida asi haiqqana gakkanaashin baqatiiddi de7ees; a ooninne shiishshi ekkenna.
verses.18: Boree bainnan hemettiya uri qohettennan attana; shin geella asi issi kuttan kunddana.
verses.19: Ba gadiyaa oottiya urai kattaa kallees. SHin shufurota kaalliya urai ubbatoo hiyyeesidi de7ees.
verses.20: Ammanettida urai daro anjjettana; shin duretanau jaamiyaagee qaxxayettennan attenna.
verses.21: SHaakkidi maaddiyoogee lo77enna; shin asi guutta oittaa gishshau giidikka, shaakkidi maaddees.
verses.22: Uuzettiya urai duretanau jaamees; bana hiyyeesatetti oiqqanaagaakka erenna.
verses.23: Asa coo sabbiya uraappe seeriya uri guyyeppe galatettees.
verses.24: Ba aawaappenne ba aayeeppe wuuqqidi, “Taani ainne nagara oottabeikke” yaagiya urainne bashshiya urai issi mala.
verses.25: Yaaretiya urai ooshshaa denttees; shin GODAN ammanettiyaagee kallees.
verses.26: Banan ammanettiya asi eeyya; shin aadhdhida eratettan hemettiyaagee saro de7ees.
verses.27: Hiyyeesau immiya urau paccenna; shin eta be7anaappe giidi qilimmiyaagee qanggettaa ekkana.
verses.28: Iita asati sunttettiyo wode, asai qosettees; shin eti xayiyo wode, xilloti corattoosona.

verses.1: Daroton seerin ixxidi, morgge zozzida urai hassayennan meqqana; he urau paxoikka baawa.
verses.2: Xillo asati sunttettiyo wode asai ufaittees; shin iitati biittaa haariyo wode asai oolees.
verses.3: Aadhdhida eraa dosiya asi ba aawaa ufaissees; shin shaaramuxa maccaasatu heeran yuuyiya asi ba miishshaa wurssees.
verses.4: Tumaa pirddiya kawoi ba kawotettaa woppu oottees; shin mattaaye maanau yiiqetiyaagee ba kawotettaa bashshees.
verses.5: Ba shooruwaa sabbidi haasayiya urai, a tohuwaassi gitiyaa yeggees.
verses.6: Iita asi gitee oiqqiyoogaadan, ba nagaran oiqettees; shin xillo asi ufaittanaunne yexxanau danddayees.
verses.7: Xillo asi hiyyeesaa maataa erees; shin iita asi hegaa mala eraa mulekka erenna.
verses.8: Qilliicciyaageeti kataman ooshshaa denttoosona; shin aadhdhida eranchcha asati hanqquwaa gabbissoosona.
verses.9: Aadhdhida eranchcha asi eeyya asa pirdda keettaa efiikko, eeyyai hanqqetteesinne qirees; au yaatobare saroi xayees.
verses.10: Suutta gussanau jaamiya asati suure asa ixxoosona; qassi xillo asakka woranau koyoosona.
verses.11: Eeyya asi ba hanqquwaa yeddi bessees; shin aadhdhida era asi ba hanqquwaa mittees.
verses.12: Issi sunttettida urai worddo odo ekkikko, a oosanchchati ubbai iita kiyoosona.
verses.13: Hiyyeesinne asa naaqqiya asi issibaa koxxoosona; eta naa77aa aifiyaakka GODAI xeelissees.
verses.14: Issi kawoi hiyyeesassi suure pirddikko, i ba kawotettan gam77ana.
verses.15: Qaixaareenne seeri naatussi aadhdhida eraa immees; shin yedan diccida na7i ba aayyiyo kaushshees.
verses.16: Iita asati dariyo wode, nagarai darees; shin xilloti eta kunddettaa be7ana.
verses.17: Ne na7aa seera; yaatikko, i nena saruwaa diggenna; i nena ufaissana.
verses.18: GODAI kaalettiyo kaaletuwaa ekkenna deree yeda; shin higgiyaa naagiya uri anjjettidaagaa.
verses.19: Ashkkari coo odo xalaalan seeretti erenna; odoi au geliyaakkokka i azazettenna.
verses.20: Eesuwan eesuwan haasayiya uraa be7a eraishsha? Appe eeyya uraassi sinttanau daro ufaissai de7ees.
verses.21: Ne ashkkaraassi naatettan doommin, i koyiyoobaa ubbaa ayyo imma meezeyikko, issi gallassi neeyyo de7iyaabaa ubbaa ekkanau i kajjeelanaagee attenna.
verses.22: Hanqqettiya asi ooshshaa denttettees; elle yiillotiya asi daro nagaraa oottees.
verses.23: Otoroi asa kaushshees; shin ziqqi giya ayyaanai de7iyo asi bonchchettees.
verses.24: Kaisoora shaakkiya uri bana ixxiya asa; i dabaaban tumaa odikkokka qaxxayettees; tumaa odana xayikko qassi, GODAI a qaxxayana.
verses.25: Asassi yayyiyoobi he aawussi pire gidees; shin GODAN ammanettiya asi saro de7ees.
verses.26: Daroti sunttatettai de7iyo asata auddashoosona; shin suure pirddai GODAA achchappe beettees.
verses.27: Xilloti nagaranchchata shenetoosona; nagaranchchatikka suure uraa shenetoosona.

verses.1: Hagaappe kaallidi xaafettidaagee Yaaqe na7ai Aguri haasayido hayyo haasayaa. He bitanee Iti7eelassinne Ukaalassi hagaa haasayiis.
verses.2: Tumu taani ai asappekka eeyyaa darais; asassi de7iya akeeki taassi de7enna.
verses.3: Taani aadhdhida eraa tamaarabeikke; Geeshsha Xoossaabaakka aibanne erikke.
verses.4: Saluwaa pude kiyidi, duge wodhdhidai oonee? Carkko ba kushen oiqqidai, haatta ba afalan yiicidai, sa7aa gaxaa a sohuwan sohuwan wottidai oonee? Ane erikko a sunttaa taayyo oda. A na7aa oona giyo?
verses.5: Xoossai odiyo qaalai ubbai tuma; baakko baqatidi biya ubbaassi i gonddalle.
verses.6: A qaalaa bolli aibanne gujjoppa; gujjikko i nena seerana; neeni worddanchcha gidiyoogaakka i qonccissana.
verses.7: Abeet GODAU, taani nena naa77ubata oichchais; taani haiqqana gakkanaashin, eta tana diggoppa.
verses.8: Koiruwan, taani asa cimmennaadaaninne worddo haasayennaadan tana naaga; naa77anttuwan, taayyo koshshiya keesa qumaa immappe attin, tana dure woikko manqqo kessoppa.
verses.9: Hinna xayikko, dure gidada, “GODAI oonee?” gaada nena kaddana; woikko manqqo gidada, wuuqqana; yaatada ta Xoossaa sunttaa cayissana.
verses.10: Nena qanggenna malanne i qanggin neeyyo gometenna mala, ashkkaraa a godaa sinttan boroppa.
verses.11: Bantta aawata qanggiyaanne bantta aayeta anjjenna asati de7oosona.
verses.12: Daro tunaa tuni uttidi, banttana geeshshadan qoodiya asati de7oosona.
verses.13: Otoruwaa meexxiya asatinne asa karidi xeelliya asati de7oosona.
verses.14: Eta achchai biso mala gidin, eta manggaagai billama mala gidin, hiyyeesatanne metootanchchata naaqqidi, etabaa bonqqiya asati de7oosona.
verses.15: Ullatteessi naa77u macca naati de7oosona. Eti, “Hamma! Hamma!” yaagidi waassoosona. Mulekka kalli erenna heezzubati de7oosona; oiddanttoi qassi mule, “Gidana” gi erenna.
verses.16: Hegeetikka: duufuwaa, maine maccaasaa, haatti kalissi erenna mela biittaanne, “Tau gidana!” gi erenna tamaa.
verses.17: Ba aawaa baceessiya na7aa aifiyaa, ba aayyiyaa cimin kariya na7aa aifiyaa, zanggaaran de7iya quuroti woocana; a ashuwaa ankkoti maana.
verses.18: Tana heezzubati maalalissoosona; oiddanttoi ubba taayyo gelenna.
verses.19: Hegeetikka: arggantti saloora paalliyo paaluwaa, shooshshi shuchchaa bollaara sololiyo sololettaa, markkabee abbaa bollan solddiyo soldduwaanne wodallinne geela7oi siiquwaa doommiyo doomettaa.
verses.20: SHaaramuxa maccaasiyaa haniyo hanoikka hegaa mala. A muussaa mausu; shin miidoogaappe guyyiyan, ba doona quccarggada, “Taani ainne moorabeikke” yaagausu.
verses.21: Heezzu yohotun biittai qaaxxees; oiddanttuwaa ubba tookkanaukka danddayibeenna.
verses.22: Hegeetikka: aillee kawotido wode, eeyyai kattaa kallido wode,
verses.23: asi ixxido maccaasiyaa azina gelido wodenne macca ashkkariyaa ba godiyo laattido wode merettiya hanotaa.
verses.24: Sa7aa bolli oiddu guutta meretati de7oosona; shin eti keehi aadhdhida eranchcha.
verses.25: Hegeetikka: Cunccalleta - cunccalleti wolqqi bainna mereta; shin banttau miyoobaa bone shiishshidi, minjjoosona.
verses.26: Guppalleta - guppalleti guutta wolqqai de7iyoogeeta; shin bantta keettaa shuchchaa kooppuwan keexxoosona.
verses.27: Booleta - booletussi kawoi baawa; shin eti ubbaikka maaran mankkan zattoosona.
verses.28: Zareta - zareti kushiyan oiqqinkka oiqettoosona; shin eti harai attin, kawo keettankka de7oosona.
verses.29: Bantta maataa bessiiddi hemettiya heezzu meretati de7oosona; oiddanttoikka lo77o hemetaa hemettees.
verses.30: Hegeetikka: do7a ubbaappe minniyanne yayyidi baqati erenna gaammuwaa;
verses.31: inddetu giddon ayyiiddi hemettiya adde kuttuwaa, deeshsha orggiyaanne ba olanchchatu giddon eqqiya kawuwaa.
verses.32: Neeni eeyyada otorettidabaa gidikkonne, iitabaa oottanau halchchidabaa gidikko, ane takki gaada qoppa.
verses.33: Maattaa bukkiyoogee oissaa kessiyoogaadan, siiriyaa yimppiyoogeekka suuttaa ehiyoogaadan, hegaadan hanqquwaa denttettiyoogee ooshshaa ehees.

verses.1: Hagaappe kaallidi xaafettida hayyo haasayai, Kawuwaa Limu7eela aayyiyaa Kawuwaa Limu7eela tamaarissidoogaa.
verses.2: “Laa ta na7au, ta uluwaappe wodhdhidaagoo, taani shiiqettada yelidoogoo,
verses.3: maccaasan ne wolqqaa wurssoppa; he kawota bashshiya maccaasatun ne akataa xaissoppa.
verses.4: “Limu7eelaa, hagee kawotussi bessenna; woiniyaa eessaa uyiyoogee kawotussi bessenna; mattoyiya ushshaa uyiyoogee deriyaa bolli sunttettidaageetussi bessenna.
verses.5: Eti uyiyo wode higgiyaa baloosona; balidi naaqettida asaa maataa shenehoo goosona.
verses.6: Mattoyiya ushshaa haiqqana haniya uraunne sa7ai iitido urau immite.
verses.7: Eti bantta manqqotettaanne bantta tugga de7uwaa dogana mala uyona.
verses.8: “Bantta metuwaa odanau danddayennaageetu gishshaa neeni oda; maaddiyaabi bainnaageetu maataa gishshau neeni bidda.
verses.9: Biddada etayyo suure pirddaa pirdda; hiyyeesatunne metootanchchatu maataa naaga” yaagada tamaarissaasu.
verses.10: Wozannaama machcho ooni demmanau danddayii? Inqquwaa giyo al77o shuchchaappekka a al77ausu.
verses.11: I keettaawai o ubbabankka ammanees; ayyo de7anau bessiyaabaappe aibinne paccenna.
verses.12: A ba de7o laitta ubban ayyo lo77obaappe attin, iitabaa oottukku.
verses.13: Suufiyaanne liinuwaa a koyada, ufaittaidda ba kushiyan oottausu.
verses.14: A zal77anchchatu markkabetu mala; ba qumaa haaho biittaappe ehausu.
verses.15: A ba so asaassi qumaa kattanaunne ba macca ashkkaratussi oosuwaa bazzanau, sa7ai biron qamma de7ishin denddausu.
verses.16: Gadiyaa a koyada shammausu; ba kushiyan oottada demmido miishshan woiniyaa turaa tokkausu.
verses.17: A gooba oosanchcha gidiyoogaa xalaala gidennan, minonne cincca asa.
verses.18: A ba woriyaa demmanau minnada zal77ausu; a oottaidda qamissiyo, ba xomppiyaa eesuwan toissukku.
verses.19: A ba hinddiriitan suqqada, ba afalaa daddausu.
verses.20: A hiyyeesatussinne metootanchchatussi babaappe coo immausu.
verses.21: I so asai ubbai ho77iya maayuwaa maayido gishshau, shachchai bukkiyaakko, a hirggukko.
verses.22: Arssaa bollan hiixxiyo maayuwaa sikkausu; liinuwaappe dadettida zo7o maayuwaakka baayyo maayausu.
verses.23: Dere cimati shiiqiyo dubbushan i keettaawai bonchchettida asa.
verses.24: Liinuwaappe maayuwaanne qabattuwaa ootta oottada, zal77anchchatussi baizzausu.
verses.25: A minonne bonchcho asa; yiya laittatussi a mulekka hirggukku.
verses.26: Aadhdhida eran a haasayausu; ammanttiya zoree i inxxarssaappe kiyees.
verses.27: A ba so asaa de7uwaa injjeyanau ubbaton ooso oottaidda de7ausu; azalla hanoi i bollan beetti erenna.
verses.28: I naati denddi eqqidi, o nashshoosona; i keettaawaikka o galatiiddi,
verses.29: “Lo77obaa oottida daro maccaasati de7oosona; shin neeni eta ubbaappe aadhdhaasa” yaagees.
verses.30: Mera lo77otetti allaalle kessenna; puulikka xayana; shin GODAASSI yayyiya maccaasiyaa, a galatettanau bessausu.
verses.31: A oottidobau ubbau iyyo i kushiya zaarite; a oottido oosoi ubbai dabaaban o galatisso.
